name: Easy Spanish chicken
assumptions: Yield estimated from 8 chicken thighs (typical 2 thighs per adult serving) plus substantial sides; consistent with similar oven-bake recipes.
Total time sums active prep (~15 min for chopping/frying) plus 40 min bake; oven preheat included conservatively.
Gluten-free: no barley/rye/wheat/oats; all listed ingredients compatible.
No fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, sesame, eggs or milk detected in ingredients list.
Olives classified as ambiguous for fish (possible cross-contact in brine but not an ingredient).
Parsley and spices treated as gluten-free unless certified otherwise but confidently absent here.
instructions:
step 1
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof frying pan over a medium heat and fry the onion, chorizo and peppers along with a pinch of salt and pepper for 15 mins until the veg has softened and the chorizo has released its oils. Add the paprika and garlic, and cook for another few minutes until fragrant.

step 2
Tip in the chopped tomatoes, olives and butter beans, stir to combine and season. Nestle in the chicken thighs and season well. Transfer to the oven and bake for 40 mins until the chicken skin is crisp and the meat cooked through and tender. Scatter with the parsley and serve.
